posts.title: Battery Energy Storage Systems | Ampcontrol
posts.copy: Reliance on renewable energy generation is growing, and so is the role of battery energy storage systems (BESS). So, where are BESS used? BESS store energy for use when it is needed, helping balance differences between when energy is generated and when it is consumed. Unlike standard UPS systems that provide short-duration backup power, BESS can deliver sustained energy output over several hours, making them suitable for off-grid power supply, peak shaving, renewable energy integration and grid stability services. posts.title: Extend the Life of High-Voltage Equipment with Maintenance and Repairs | Ampcontrol posted on the topic
posts.copy: Ageing high-voltage equipment doesn't automatically need replacing. A transformer that's been in service for thirty years might need a rewind, a tap changer overhaul, or nothing more than a maintenance visit. Our HV field service teams do all of that work, from engineering and compliance through testing, commissioning, maintenance, overhauls and refurbishment. By supporting them throughout their lifecycle, your assets stay in service longer, and you can save replacement budget for the assets that genuinely need it.
